text_en: The PRESIDENT opened the debate upon the articles of the text of the Drafting Committee which had been reserved and had not been dealt with at the meetings of July 19th and 20th.

text_fr: LE PRESIDENT rappelle que déjà en 1907 on a consacré la règle de la juridiction obligatoire pour certains conflits internationaux.
text_en: The PRESIDENT pointed out that the rules of compulsory jurisdiction for certain international disputes had already been recognised in 1907.

text_fr: A la suite de la discussion, l'article 29 est adopté sans modifications. Une addition est faite à l'article 28 bis (voir ci-dessus).
text_en: Following upon this discussion, Article 29 was adopted without alteration. One addition was made to Article 28 bis (See above).

text_fr: M. LODER fait valoir la nécessité d'arrêter des règles pour la procédure sommaire. Il attire l'attention sur l'article 51 du projet des Cinq Puissances.
text_en: M. LODER pointed out the necessity of laying down rules for the summary procedure. He called attention to Article 51 of the Five Powers' plan.

text_fr: Le PRESIDENT se réfère aux règles adoptées en 1907.
text_en: The PRESIDENT referred to the rules adopted in 1907.

text_fr: LORD PHILLIMORE propose la suppression des mots „en procédure sommaire" à l'article 24.
text_en: LORD PHILLIMORE proposed that the words "by summary procedure" in Article 24 should be deleted.

text_fr: Mr. ROOT suggère l'idée de laisser à la Cour le soin d'établir un règlement pour la procédure sommaire.
text_en: Mr. ROOT suggested that the regulation of the summary procedure should be left to the Court.

text_fr: Sur la proposition de M. DE LAPRADELLE on se met d'accord pour ajouter au commencement de l'alinéa la formule suivante:
text_en: At the suggestion of M. DE LAPRADELLE, the Committee agreed to add the following words to the Paragraph:

text_fr: „Sauf exception expressément prévue...“ Cette formule, mise au vote, est adoptée.
text_en: “Except when it is expressly provided otherwise...”
This wording was put to the vote and adopted.

text_fr: Le PRESIDENT déclare ne pouvoir pas prendre part à un vote portant sur des dispositions qu'il regrette au point de vue du bon fonctionnement de la Cour.
text_en: The PRESIDENT declared that he could not take part in a vote on the subject of provisions which he thought would be detrimental to the performance of the Court's functions.

text_en: M. RICCI-BUSATTI wished to substitute the expression “juridical interpretation” for the expression “determination of rules of law”: This proposal was rejected.

text_en: In order to meet the objections raised by M. Hagerup, during the discussion of Article 29 no. 2, the Committee agreed to insert the following words in Paragraph 2 of Article 15 :

text_fr: „non seulement qu'elle a compétence mais . . .” entre les mots „s'assurer” et „que ces conclusions”.
text_en: “Not only that it has jurisdiction but also . . .” between the words “satisfy itself” and “that the claim”.

text_fr: M. HAGERUP formule des objections contre la disposition d'après laquelle „l'autre partie peut demander à la Cour . . . etc.” Il va de soi que cette faculté appartient à la partie en question. Cette ob
text_en: M. HAGERUP objected to the provision, by which “the other party may call upon the Court . . . etc.” The party in question would naturally have this right. This proposal was not taken into consideratio

text_fr: La rédaction de l'alinéa 1er, qui avait été réservée, est complétée par l'addition des mots „et que la partie, sans faute de sa part, pouvait ne pas connaître.”
text_en: The wording of the first Paragraph, which had been reserved, was completed by the addition of the words: “and of which the said party might be ignorant, through no fault of its own.”

text_fr: L'article sous cette nouvelle forme est adopté.
text_en: The Article was adopted with this new wording.

text_fr: Des objections sont soulevées contre l'expression „intérêts d'ordre juridique”. Ces objections ne donnent pas lieu à des modifications.
text_en: Some objections were raised to the expression “interests of a legal nature”, but did not give rise to any alterations.

text_fr: Mr. ROOT attire l'attention sur les vœux provisoirement adoptés par le Comité et qui attendent un vote définitif.
text_en: Mr. ROOT drew attention to the resolutions, which had been provisionally adopted by the Committee, but had yet to be put to a final vote.

text_fr: Le PRESIDENT met aux voix le premier vœu, proposé par M. Root et le Baron Descamps et relatif à la convocation de conférences périodiques pour le progrès du droit international.
text_en: The PRESIDENT took a vote upon the first resolution which he and Mr. Root had proposed, concerning the convocation of periodical conferences for the development of international Law.

text_fr: Ce vœu est adopté, avec l'addition, dans l'énumération des grandes académies internationales, de la „International Law Association”, et sauf rédaction.
text_en: This resolution was adopted subject to amendment in wording. In the enumeration of great international academies, the International Law Association was added.

text_fr: Le second vœu concernant l'établissement d'une juridiction internationale en matière criminelle, proposé par le Président, est maintenant présenté par lui dans une nouvelle rédaction qui est adoptée à
text_en: The second resolution concerning the establishment of an international jurisdiction for criminal cases, proposed by the President, was then presented by him in a new form, which was unanimously adopte

text_fr: M. LODER donne lecture d'un troisième projet de vœu, relatif à l'établissement d'une Académie de droit international à La Haye.
text_en: M. LODER read a third draft resolution, concerning the establishment of an Academy of International Law at The Hague.

text_en: M. DE LAPRADELLE also pointed out the difference between the two first and the last resolutions. The former had to be presented to the League of Nations, whereas the latter did not concern the League.

text_fr: Une nouvelle rédaction du vœu de M. Loder, tenant compte des observations qui viennent d'être indiquées, est adoptée à l'unanimité.
text_en: A new wording of M. Loder's resolution, drawn up in accordance with the observations mentioned above, was unanimously adopted.
